t: What Climate Adaptation Intervention Database Is All About
title: What Climate Adaptation Intervention Database Is All About
description: Adaptation reduces climate harm where mitigation can't reach in time: the Netherlands' Delta Works (post-1953 flood), Bangladesh's cyclone shelters (deaths from 500,000 in 1970 to thousands), and cool roofs in Ahmedabad (heat action plans). Measures are compared by avoided damage per dollar, with residual risk honestly stated — adaptation has limits, and maladaptation (seawalls worsening erosion next door) must be screened out. This database is the complete adaptation measure: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
